name: B10-0423/2026 – After recital F – Am 1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: Fa. whereas in its Special Report No 11/2025 entitled ‘Transparency of EU funding granted to NGOs’, the European Court of Auditors concluded that, due to inconsistent classification and data quality issues, there cannot be a reliable overview of the beneficiaries and the amounts transferred; whereas the lack of transparency lays the groundwork for misspending and corruption;
